chunks: Have We not destroyed the earlier generations?
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'destroyed the earlier generations'?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Mursalat, this rhetorical question underscores the inevitability of divine retribution by recalling the destruction of earlier nations, a theme central to Shia exegesis as a warning against spiritual complacency. It serves not only as a historical precedent but also as a call to reflection (tafakkur) for the contemporary audience, urging them to align their actions with divine will before facing similar fate.
